summary.text: Jeff Thompson is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 28, has served since 1998, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a former high school science and math teacher.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Thompson's professional experience includes working as a chemistry, physics and math teacher at Danville Community High School, and Ballotpedia lists a 1978 bachelor's degree from Purdue University.
Thompson assumed office in 1998 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat Karen Whitney.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Ways and Means Committee, which he chairs.
